requirements.description: The user requires energy class D or better, so the filter keeps classes A1 through D. Area, capacity, Turin location and nearby parks are not energy-related columns and are not handled here.
User explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 15 people is not converted to an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

The user prefers parks nearby for a children's play space and hourly childcare. 'Nearby' is a proximity expression, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded up to 75 to keep the value at or above that percentile.
